thread:
ava: Heads-up — our new q4b-longctx build started pushing samples into the labeler queue at 11:10 and we just hit a surge. Lots of near-duplicates coming from the new sampler config.
liam: saw it. what sampler change caused this?
ava: changed dedupe window from 128 -> 32 to favor diversity for long prompts (experiment), but that seems to have amplified paraphrase near-duplicates.
rachel: labeler throughput is fine but their UI is showing many repeated contexts; they're skipping but it's burning golden review time. can we throttle the feed? @samir any quick wins on the ingestion side?
samir: yes — I can add a temporary filter to collapse exact-match hashes and a light semantic fingerprint dedupe (fast, bloom + sim threshold) for the next 30m. will push a hotfix to ingest-svc.
jordyn: also saw quality diffs when we ran q4b vs q8 baseline on the small eval set — some hallucination increases on code prompts. we should pause new golden promotions until we confirm.
liam: agree. put a soft block on any golden-marking rules in the curation UI?
ava: can we fallback evals to unquantized model for canary comparisons while we stabilize sampler? that will keep regression checks consistent.
samir: yep — routing flag ready. setting route: evals -> model:main:fp16 until 1765555200.
ingest-bot: ingest-svc hotfix deployed by samir at 1765554380 — exact-hash collapse enabled.
rachel: thanks. i'll message labeler ops to pause golden promotion. also creating a short checklist for labelers: 1) prefer longer unique context, 2) flag paraphrase clusters, 3) mark anything likely sampling artifact with tag `sampling-artifact`.
jordyn: adding to that — include the quick heuristic we used so labelers can dedupe locally: check first 64 chars + normalized whitespace + tokenized fingerprint.
liam: after the immediate triage, we need an RCA: why dedupe window dropped the signal so much. possible causes: tokenizer changes in q4b build, longer truncation points, or sampler state bug. assigning: liam + ava to investigate; samir for ingest metrics; jordyn + rachel for golden policy fallout.
ava: will run a small repro — grab 2k samples from before/after change and run pairwise sim to quantify cluster growth. estimated finish by EOD.
samir: metrics note: ingest duplicates spiked ~6x between 11:09-11:14 and dropped to normal after hotfix. storing raw hashes to s3 path: s3://lab-scrape/ingest/1765554321/duplicates.log
rachel: creating a temp holdout: do not promote any new gold from the `q4b-longctx` tag until we signoff. will also re-run the golden candidate eval against fp16 baseline.
liam: thanks all. follow-ups: (a) ava to share repro + cluster stats, (b) samir to attach sample of collapsed clusters, (c) jordyn/rachel to draft labeler guidance and re-promote policy. sync in ~2 hours in #eng-ml if we need to open a postmortem. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ava: copied. starting extraction now — will post a short artifact list here when ready.
